historicalDataConfidence: Complete recorded match section and final table survive; calculated values remain compatibility evidence because the exact frontend/configuration revision is unknown.
matchTerminationRule: A match could end when the assigned target was reached or when the 20-inning cap was reached.

exportedConfiguration.rankingSystem: Point Differential 14.1 (MP -> Point Diff -> 14.1 PERF -> GD -> HS)

knownLimitations: The exact legacy frontend revision is unknown.
Exported target values are preserved and may not represent the effective target used during play.
A score exceeding exportedTarget is not treated as evidence that the CSV is wrong because the 20-inning termination rule also applied.
Two players have no Round 5 result and the surviving data does not explain why.
No tournament-director-confirmed actual target overrides were supplied.
knownConfigurationUncertainty: Exact d and match-component K values are not exported.
Target-scaling details and any mid-event configuration changes are not fully preserved.
Player IDs, registration order, seeding method, and manual interventions are not preserved.
